prompt: Write pseudocode for a simple moving average crossover trading strategy.
response:
Here's pseudocode for a simple moving average crossover trading strategy:

```pseudocode
TRADING_STRATEGY_DAEMON MovingAverageCrossover

// Configuration Parameters
FAST_MA_PERIOD = 20
SLOW_MA_PERIOD = 50
POSITION_SIZE = 1000  // shares or units
STOP_LOSS_PCT = 0.02  // 2% stop loss
TAKE_PROFIT_PCT = 0.04  // 4% take profit

// State Variables
current_position = NONE  // LONG, SHORT, NONE
entry_price = 0
price_buffer = CircularBuffer(SLOW_MA_PERIOD)
fast_ma_buffer = CircularBuffer(FAST_MA_PERIOD)
slow_ma_buffer = CircularBuffer(SLOW_MA_PERIOD)

MAIN_LOOP:
    WHILE market_is_open() DO
        
        // Data Collection Phase
        current_price = get_latest_price()
        IF current_price == NULL THEN
            log_error("Price feed unavailable")
            CONTINUE
        END IF
        
        price_buffer.add(current_price)
        
        // Ensure sufficient data for calculations
        IF price_buffer.size() < SLOW_MA_PERIOD THEN
            CONTINUE
        END IF
        
        // Calculate Moving Averages
        fast_ma = calculate_sma(price_buffer, FAST_MA_PERIOD)
        slow_ma = calculate_sma(price_buffer, SLOW_MA_PERIOD)
        
        previous_fast_ma = fast_ma_buffer.get_last()
        previous_slow_ma = slow_ma_buffer.get_last()
        
        fast_ma_buffer.add(fast_ma)
        slow_ma_buffer.add(slow_ma)
        
        // Skip if insufficient history for crossover detection
        IF previous_fast_ma == NULL OR previous_slow_ma == NULL THEN
            CONTINUE
        END IF
        
        // Signal Detection
        bullish_crossover = (previous_fast_ma <= previous_slow_ma) AND (fast_ma > slow_ma)
        bearish_crossover = (previous_fast_ma >= previous_slow_ma) AND (fast_ma < slow_ma)
        
        // Position Management
        EXECUTE_STRATEGY(bullish_crossover, bearish_crossover, current_price)
        
        // Risk Management Check
        CHECK_RISK_MANAGEMENT(current_price)
        
        // Status Reporting
        log_status(current_position, fast_ma, slow_ma, current_price)
        
        sleep(evaluation_interval)
    END WHILE

FUNCTION EXECUTE_STRATEGY(bullish_signal, bearish_signal, price)
    IF current_position == NONE THEN
        IF bullish_signal THEN
            ENTER_LONG_POSITION(price)
        ELSE IF bearish_signal THEN
            ENTER_SHORT_POSITION(price)
        END IF
        
    ELSE IF current_position == LONG THEN
        IF bearish_signal THEN
            CLOSE_POSITION(price)
        END IF
        
    ELSE IF current_position == SHORT THEN
        IF bullish_signal THEN
            CLOSE_POSITION(price)
        END IF
    END IF
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION ENTER_LONG_POSITION(price)
    IF place_buy_order(POSITION_SIZE, price) == SUCCESS THEN
        current_position = LONG
        entry_price = price
        log_trade("LONG ENTRY", price)
    END IF
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION ENTER_SHORT_POSITION(price)
    IF place_sell_order(POSITION_SIZE, price) == SUCCESS THEN
        current_position = SHORT
        entry_price = price
        log_trade("SHORT ENTRY", price)
    END IF
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION CHECK_RISK_MANAGEMENT(current_price)
    IF current_position == NONE THEN RETURN
    
    price_change = (current_price - entry_price) / entry_price
